customize.text:
Ancient Sacred Mountain
<color=#ffffff>Quest Description:</color> <color=#ffffff>The Heart of the Sacred Mountain is infested by the Abyss. Its influence must be eliminated.</color>
Quest Objective: Enter the huge space beneath the volcano
Quest Objective: Talk to Paimon
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> Huh... Who'd have thought there'd be such a huge space underneath this volcano?
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> And it's wall-to-wall Abyss in here... Now that Paimon thinks about it, the Abyss covering the entrance probably crawled up from down here...
<color=#ffffff>O Chosen of Dragons, the power of blazing fire now rests within you...</color>
<color=#ffffff>Go forth and vanquish the great enemy cloaked in shadow!</color>
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> Huh. What's this fuzzy warm strength Paimon feels all over...?
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> Eh, that's a "later" question. Let's use it to send the Abyss packing, right here and now!
<color=#ffffff>Little One:</color> Rawr!
Quest Objective: Clear out the Abyss and release the Astral Assemblage(s)
Quest Objective: Clear out the Oozing Cores
Quest Objective: Destroy the Oozing Cores before they can escape
Quest Objective: Release all the Astral Assemblages
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> What... are we supposed to do about that...
<color=#ffffff>Come, Chosen of Dragons... Let the... form your path...</color>
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> Oh! There's a path. Let's go, then!
<color=#ffffff>Little One:</color> Raaawr! Roawr!
